name: Fakespot AI text detector (roberta-base)
limitations: Trained on newer LLM outputs than the GPT-2-era OpenAI detector, but still an English-centric classifier — re-validate on target-domain samples before trusting thresholds.
The model is fetched from Hugging Face on first use (~500 MB into the HF cache); set 'hub_model' to a local snapshot directory to run fully offline.
Prioritization signal, not a truth label — short text and non-English text remain unreliable.
notes: Label order for this checkpoint is index 0 = Human, index 1 = AI — verified against the model's config.json id2label (opposite of the OpenAI detector, which is 0=Fake).
Pair with models/openai-detector-runtime.json via a directory --model-path to get a two-member text ensemble with an agreement signal.
